scripts.test: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then DOTENV="dotenv -e ../.env --"; else DOTENV=""; fi; PRISMA_SCHEMA_DISABLE_ADVISORY_LOCK=true $DOTENV prisma migrate reset --force && PRISMA_SCHEMA_DISABLE_ADVISORY_LOCK=true $DOTENV prisma migrate dev && $DOTENV prisma generate && $DOTENV ts-node prisma/seed.ts && $DOTENV vitest run'
scripts.db:migrate: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../.env -- prisma migrate dev; else prisma migrate dev; fi'
scripts.db:generate: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../.env -- prisma generate; else prisma generate; fi'
scripts.db:studio: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../.env -- prisma studio; else prisma studio; fi'
scripts.db:seed: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../.env -- ts-node prisma/seed.ts; else ts-node prisma/seed.ts; fi'
scripts.db:reset: bash -lc 'if [ -f ../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../.env -- prisma migrate reset --force; else prisma migrate reset --force; fi'
